subject: ist-s-algn
title: IST.S.ALGN.------MT.INFO.
description: First of two diagrams in CS-14 (Creativity and Science, section 14). The following prose discusses how 'the affinity adaptation of western science has moved to advance the nature of aspect-essence perception dynamics.' The crossing diagrams how isolated systematic alignment structurally meets multi-information at the aspect-essence-perception scale: (C)IST-S-ALGN (the concept of isolated systematic alignment) crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). IST-S-ALGN sits on the left with the subject-arrow; the main line ends at MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) at upper-center — no label MT-INFO is drawn. SPTC-D (spectacle diversion) drops from the main line, and INFO-DY (information dynamics) branches from the main line to the right, with (P)RE-DIFF (the point of idea completion of redefinitions) branching from INFO-DY and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) from RE-DIFF. EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) also branches from INFO-DY, with IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) branching from EXP-DY, MT-INFO-DB from IF-ST-DY, and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) from MT-INFO-DB.
